query:
SELECT 
  c.id as categoryId,
  c.name as categoryName,
  SUM(poi.quantity * poi.unitCost) as amount
FROM purchaseOrderItems poi
INNER JOIN purchaseOrders po ON poi.purchaseOrderId = po.id
INNER JOIN products p ON poi.productId = p.id
INNER JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id
WHERE po.status = 'CONFIRMED'
  AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(po.postingDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) >= '2026-02-01'
  AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(po.postingDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) <= '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY amount DESC
